strings.translation: Sleep: puts an enemy group to sleep
Map: where you are, and where you've been
Sparks: 1-8 damage to an enemy group
Shield: one ally's AC drops by 2
Gloom: an enemy group's AC rises
Fear: enemy group AC +4, and held fast
Barrier: a wall that stops enemy spells
Float: rise above traps; lasts long
Summon: calls up a demon from below
Ward: walls enemies off from casting
Ice Storm: 44-98 damage to a group
Teleport: go anywhere; random in battle
Wish: special effects, but lose a level
Shield: the caster's AC drops by 4
Sight: nearly always spots chest traps
Silence: an enemy group can't cast
Cure: one ally recovers from paralysis
Shield: the party's AC drops by 3
Cure: cures one ally of poison
Shield: party AC drops by 2; lasts long
Bless: full HP; cures all but death, ash
Drain: leaves one enemy a sliver of HP
Banish: sends a demon back to its world
Revive: raises the dead or ash, full HP
Death: stops an enemy group's hearts
Might: party hits harder for a few steps
Ki Wave: damage of half HP; weakens
Haste: one ally attacks more, AC -1
Fire Mist: 1-4 damage to a group
Clear Sky: lifts clouds off the party
Ice Mist: 2-8 damage to a group
Drowse: sleep dust over all enemies
Might: party hits harder; lasts long
Glow Mist: 3-12 damage to a group
Guard: party resists magic; lasts long
Reflect: may bounce enemy spells back
Flame Mist: 4-20 damage to a group
Cure Mist: party ailments but death, stone
Ray Mist: 5-40 damage to a group
Acid: turns weak monsters to dust
Unlock: doors and trapped chests; can fail
Low Mist: 4-60 damage to a group
Mind Blast: 1-10 mental damage to one
Secret Art: heals one ally 2-6 HP
Sense: finds secret doors; lasts long
Scout: see one block ahead of the party
Bind: suggestion holds an enemy group
Vanish: caster hides, ambushes next turn
Focus: party's attack spells grow stronger
Weak Wave: an enemy group hits softer
Phantom: an illusion fights as if real
Return: back to the castle; items lost
Mind Arrow: 8-64 damage to a group
Alch Wave: 12-48 to all, plus ailments
Psi Wave: 9-72 mental damage to all
Plea: grants a special wish; stats change
